segments.contextBefore: This option allows a single set of configurations and assets to be compatible with older and newer versions of a managed app, where the older version supports only the legacy app configuration data capability, and the newer version uses the [`ManagedApp`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/ManagedApp) framework.
segments.contextAfter: This allows the developer to update the app without breaking MDM servers that haven’t transitioned to declarative app configuration yet.
